messages:
maria: Quick pulse on console observability roadmap — who owns the retention milestone + tracing hooks? Need a short list of owners, key deps, and blockers; PM sync tomorrow 11am PST. TL;DR please :pray:
samir: I own tracing hooks. Instrumentation PR is open (WIP). ETA Wed EOD. Blocker: need trace header added from eng-runtime to propagate request_id. cc @kai
kai: I can add the header. Plan to expose `x-rd-request-id` on the runtime side by Tue morning. Low risk but need the exact routes that should be traced. @vidya can you list them?
vidya: Routes I care about: `/v1/generate`, `/v1/chat`, `/v1/embeddings`, `/internal/batch/*`.
vidya: Also proposal: initial trace retention = 90d for spans, 30d for raw logs. Ops needs rough size estimate before we commit.
jess: Dashboards update: landing per-route latency + p95/p99 panels today, will canary to staging. Need an example query for error analysis grouped by model/version. Suggest: `sum(rate(request_errors[5m])) by (model_version)`
samir: Re: logs in traces — we should strip heavy fields. Add filter on agent side: ```py
TRACE_EXCLUDE_FIELDS = ["cache_payload", "kv_cache"]
```
so we don't blow up storage.
ops-bot: Deploy pipeline note: staging -> canary -> prod. Canary window 2h. If error rate spike >3x baseline, auto-rollback. @samir please attach rollback doc to PR.
kai: Confirmed I'll expose the header + add a feature flag `rd.enable_tracing_headers` so we can toggle during canary.
maria: Great. Two asks: 1) everyone add owner + blockers as a single checkbox in the tracker issue by EOD; 2) attach any perf/memory impact numbers to the PRs. I'll pull into the PM brief before 11am PST.
samir: Will add a quick rollback runbook and perf numbers to the PR today.
jess: I'll link the dashboard JSON and sample queries to the tracker.
vidya: I'll estimate storage impact for 90/30 retention and post numbers here in a bit.
maria: Thanks — if anything changes ping here. Otherwise I'll consolidate and send to PMs in 30m :thumbsup:
